decisions.reason: With its own website page since launch and central fit to the firm's digital integration strategy, A has high sunk investment and public commitment, so escalation makes dropping unlikely.
B was upgraded from a mention to its own page in 2024, signaling increased public commitment and resource investment, so the firm persists rather than withdraw.
Like B, C moved from mention to own page, showing escalating commitment to billing software in the established offer, making withdrawal less likely under the theory.
D's promotion to its own page in 2024 indicates growing commitment and sunk costs in monitoring software, so management continues the product.
